messages:
deploy-bot: Rollout initiated by alex — release=v3.4.0

deploy-bot: slice=us-east1 index=1/3 canary=1% -> 10% over 10m

alex: Kicking off US canary now. Priya monitoring?

priya: Watching p50/p95 and request queue depth. Dash: <https://dash.redwood.internal/runs/3.4.0-canary>

sasha: Quick heads-up — autoscale quota in apac-sg1 at 82% used

martin: If apac quota < 100% we should hold APAC and pin model there to v3.3.7

alex: Agree. Plan: proceed with US now, EU next if green, APAC hold until quota freed. Pin command ready.

martin: Pin command (dry-run):
```
deployctl pin-version --region apac-sg1 --service inference --version v3.3.7 --reason "quota hold"
```

priya: Rollback/hold triggers: p50 > 220ms for 5m OR error_rate > 1% over 3m -> abort and rollback to v3.3.7. Also watch queue_depth > 120.

oncall-bot: Alert rule created: canary-latency-watch (threshold=220ms, window=5m)

alex: US canary -> 5% now. @priya can you confirm when p50 stable for 10m and I'll promote EU slice.

priya: p50 160ms, p95 340ms, errors 0.3% — holding 10m verification

sasha: Noted, starting manual quota request to infra for apac pool bump.

martin: If infra can't bump, we'll run failover: route APAC traffic to eu-west1 as temporary measure, then pin apac to v3.3.7.

alex: Sounds good. I'll update release notes and include pin decisions in the release thread. :thumbsup:
